paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption_used: Training loss curves over iterations for Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), and four SepLLM configurations. All models start with loss values exceeding 3.4 and converge as training progresses to 140,000 iterations. The Vanilla model achieves the lowest final loss at approximately 2.45, while StrmLLM (n=64) converges to roughly 2.60, showing a notable gap from the SepLLM variants. Among the SepLLM configurations, the H/T variant reaches the lowest loss at approximately 2.49, with SepLLM (n=128) settling at approximately 2.55, slightly above both the base SepLLM (n=64) and SepLLM (n=64, H) which converge near 2.51-2.52. The most rapid decrease in loss occurs within the first 20,000 iterations for all models, after which convergence slows considerably.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training loss curves over iterations for six different model configurations: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), and four variants of SepLLM — SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis, labeled “#Iteration,” spans from 0 to 140,000 in linear scale with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 in linear scale, with tick marks and gridlines every 0.1 unit. All models begin training with initial loss values above 3.4, showing a steep decline in the first 20,000 iterations, after which the rate of loss reduction slows significantly. The purple “Vanilla” line converges to the lowest final loss of approximately 2.45. The blue “StrmLLM (n=64)” line ends at roughly 2.60, noticeably higher than all SepLLM variants. Among the SepLLM configurations, the red “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” line reaches the lowest loss among them at approximately 2.49, followed closely by the green “SepLLM (n=64, H)” and orange “SepLLM (n=64)” lines, both converging near 2.51–2.52. The dark blue “SepLLM (n=128)” line settles slightly higher at approximately 2.55. All lines are solid with no markers, and the legend is positioned in the upper right corner.
